name: Huralok
description: Huraloks were sapient reptilians indigenous to Djurmo. They were known to be a vicious species that held long grudges with other beings and even their own. Huraloks were extremely long-lived, living to as old as the mid 300s.

data.name: Huralok
data.distinctions: Triangular heads, thick claws, black-striped scales
